wall_sampling.ruling: The DIII-D onboarding lane owns the active source file, so this bundle records the required 33-to-65 change and its 1.97x wall-target cost without crossing that lane's write surface.

reference_suite.evidence_default_rule: EVIDENCE_CELLS aliases SUITE_CELLS instead of owning a second implicit carrier.

cache_policy.rule: The parity consumer derives the semantic cache group from the reference module's suite owner instead of pinning a duplicate key.

module_timing.cache_state: warm semantic carrier in both runs

reference_suite.classification: The mesh-independent coupled-map response remains deliberately visible; changing the carrier does not recategorise or hide it.

shell_spacing.rule: A concrete machine description supplies a positive physical shell spacing in metres. Generic Frame.dshell=0 only preserves authored vertices; it is not an accuracy default, and no shell spacing is derived from a plasma-cell count.

consumers.role: passes the machine-owned value into the shell constructor
meshes each machine-model shell segment using MachineData.dshell
passes the selected machine's dshell into passive thick-line insertion

rectangular_target_authority.shared_rule: Generic Biot targets remain disabled at None. Each consumer that creates a rectangular target owns its requested count according to that output domain and its own convergence evidence; a stored-map axis count is not silently imposed on unrelated targets.

authorities.consumer_contract: geometry-generic equilibrium extrapolation domain, with IDS-native sizing available

rectangular_target_authority.reason_not_unified_at_4225: Only a consumer judged on a stored 65 by 65 flux map owns the 4225-node identity. Extrapolation, pulse-design contouring and waveform contouring have different domains and outputs, so replacing their counts with one map-derived constant would exchange visible duplicate values for a hidden, scientifically false shared authority.
rectangular_target_authority.future_change_gate: A consumer may change its count only with convergence evidence for its own output; generic Biot defaults remain None.

verification.routed_external_defect: nova/imas/waveform.py and nova/imas/fuse.py import Ids from its former module; a separate owner node is repairing that pre-existing defect, which is excluded from this bundle.
